concerns.text: T012 (Orchestrate data fetch) lists T040 (Strict Fetch) and T012a (Snowball Sampling) as prerequisites, but T040 and T012a are marked as incomplete (no checkmark). T012 cannot execute without the implementation of its blocking dependencies. This violates the 'Producer before Consumer' rule.

T012b (Validate subgraph representativeness) depends on T012a and T012. Since T012 is blocked by incomplete tasks (T040, T012a), T012b is also blocked. Furthermore, T012b requires the output of T012 (the graph), which does not exist yet.

T024 (Save final dataset) depends on T016 (Save processed graph). T016 depends on T012, which is blocked by incomplete upstream tasks (T040, T012a). The dependency chain is broken at the ingestion layer, preventing the final dataset from being generated.

T037 (Integration test for statistical pipeline) requires input `data/processed/final_analysis_dataset.parquet`. This artifact is produced by T024, which is blocked by the incomplete ingestion chain (T040 -> T012 -> T016). The test cannot run until the data flow is unblocked.

T040 is marked as 'BLOCKING' but has no checkmark (incomplete). The task description implies it must be completed before T012, yet the ordering suggests T012 is the final step of Phase 2. The status of T040 creates a logical deadlock in the phase execution order.

T016 depends on T012, T013, T014. T012 is blocked by incomplete tasks. T013 and T014 are marked complete. The dependency on T012 makes T016 unexecutable, creating a gap in the artifact flow between ingestion and storage.
